name: Toudou Miyu
source:
A bright and an honest girl.
Being an extreme glossophobia, Miyu's stranger anxiety is abnormal.
However, when she transforms, her personality becomes that who would express her happiness can be seen from her whole body and would become depress when feeling even a little disheartening.
